opportunityOfTheWeek.name: Downtown San Diego Partnership: Local Meetings & Catering
opportunityOfTheWeek.hotelRationale: Wyndham Bayside is a bayfront full-service meetings hotel (~15 rooms / 27k sq ft) competing in the same downtown waterfront banquet catchment as Hilton Bayfront. Plausible alternate or overflow host for Partnership dinners when capacity/date fit.
opportunityOfTheWeek.recommendedNextAction: Email Kathryn Newstead (knewstead@downtownsandiego.org) to introduce Wyndham San Diego Bayside as a bayfront banquet option for future Partnership dinners and ask how venue selection runs for the next awards cycle.
